description: This file defines the class DynamoDBRemindersProviderBuilder which implements the IProviderBuilder interface for configuring DynamoDB reminder services within Orleans SiloBuilder. It includes a method Configure that reads configuration settings and applies them to set up DynamoDB reminders.

classes.name: DynamoDBRemindersProviderBuilder
classes.description: A class that builds and configures DynamoDB reminder service provider for Orleans Silo.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the ISiloBuilder to use DynamoDB reminder service with settings read from the provided configuration section.
